title: C-Street City Market
notes: Verified on the market site and its public Google Calendar (embedded on cstreetcitymarket.org; cstreetmarket.org does not resolve). The homepage says the 2026 season is mid March through October, 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Calendar events titled Market Day are Saturdays 9:00-14:00 (2026-05-02 is 8:00-14:00). Season starts 03-14 to include the 2026-03-14 first market day.
